messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: rhbase 1.1.1 released
parts:
This release just removes some CR/LF characters that had slipped into an installation script, breaking it on some platforms (I am afraid all Unix-like ones) during a repo reorg in response to the removal of a Github feature, the Downloads page. While we were at it, we removed them from every text file and set up git so that they are removed automatically on check in. Hopefully this will make such mishaps less likely. Apologies to those who tried to install rhbase in the last few days and thanks Nicolas for reporting the problem.


Antonio
